description: This is a unit test class for the 'Currencies' module in SuiteCRM, testing various functionalities such as currency conversion, retrieval, display, and dropdown generation.

classes.name: CurrencyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the Currencies module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment, initializes global variables and configuration.

methods.name: testCurrency
methods.description: Tests the instantiation and basic properties of the Currency bean.

methods.name: testconvertToDollar
methods.description: Tests the conversion of currency to dollar using the convertToDollar method.

methods.name: testconvertFromDollar
methods.description: Tests the conversion from dollar to currency using the convertFromDollar method.

methods.name: testgetDefaultCurrencyName
methods.description: Verifies the default currency name returned by the getter.

methods.name: testgetDefaultCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Verifies the default currency symbol returned by the getter.

methods.name: testgetDefaultISO4217
methods.description: Checks the default ISO 4217 currency code.

methods.name: testretrieveIDBySymbol
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of currency ID by symbol, including empty input.

methods.name: testlist_view_parse_additional_sections
methods.description: Tests parsing additional sections for list views, including merge sections.

methods.name: testretrieve_id_by_name
methods.description: Tests retrieving currency ID by name.

methods.name: testretrieve
methods.description: Tests retrieving a currency bean and its attributes.

methods.name: testgetPdfCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Tests getting the PDF currency symbol.

methods.name: testget_list_view_data
methods.description: Verifies the list view data array returned by get_list_view_data.

methods.name: testsave
methods.description: Tests saving a currency bean and marking it deleted.

methods.name: testcurrency_format_number
methods.description: Tests formatting numbers with the currency_format_number function.

methods.name: testformat_number
methods.description: Tests the format_number function with various options.

methods.name: testformat_place_symbol
methods.description: Tests formatting numbers with currency symbols placed either before or after.

methods.name: testunformat_number
methods.description: Tests removing formatting from formatted currency strings.

methods.name: testformat_money
methods.description: Tests consistent formatting of money values.

methods.name: testget_number_separators
methods.description: Verifies number separators returned by get_number_separators.

methods.name: testget_number_seperators
methods.description: Verifies get_number_seperators with false parameter returns null.

methods.name: testtoString
methods.description: Tests the toString function for output format.

methods.name: testgetCurrencyDropDown
methods.description: Tests the HTML dropdown generation for currencies in different views.

methods.name: testgetCurrencyNameDropDown
methods.description: Tests the currency name dropdown HTML generation.

methods.name: testgetCurrencySymbolDropDown
methods.description: Tests the currency symbol dropdown HTML generation.
